readerQuestion: How can Home Assistant send a phone reminder before each timed appointment, including simultaneous events, without unexpected all-day alerts?
selectedBecause: Calendar notifications have a clear household outcome and recurring independent community discussion: the maintained Calendar Notifications & Actions thread has 2026 support exchanges about offsets and all-day behavior, and a May 2026 Reddit discussion describes appointment preparation reminders. Exact-query results checked today include both an older Local Calendar tutorial and the maintained blueprint. A compact built-in configuration with a two-appointment rehearsal, explicit all-day exclusion, offset arithmetic, and separate calendar/phone checks adds practical value without replacing the existing daily trash reminder or completion-based chores owners. No search-volume claim is made.

searchReview.intent: Set up advance phone reminders for individual calendar events and understand missing, overlapping, or midnight reminders.
searchReview.resultGap: Current exact-query search results include a configurable community blueprint and an older Local Calendar tutorial. Both are useful. This article adds a short built-in-only recipe, explicit timed-event scope, separate notification delivery test, two simultaneous appointment rehearsal, and why a 15-minute offset requires testing further ahead than 15 minutes. Direct Google results access was attempted in the browser and web tool; Google returned HTTP 429 and the web open failed. Search-provider results were reviewed instead; no Google rank or result-order claims are made. This access limitation remains documented rather than represented as a successful direct Google review.
